_README: Muscles of the male right forearm the cryosection photographs do not separate (vhm_forearm_muscles_from_cryo.py): each compartment is the union of its members' watershed regions and is mapped to null. Decided from the run's report (boundary_support: within-compartment boundary on a pale line, ridge ratio >= 1.8, at < 70 % of shared levels), 2026-09-14.

radial_flexor_compartment.note: PT/FPL split followed a pale line at 63 % of 27 shared levels and FCR/FPL at 66 % of 35; PT's region (7 cm3) is far too small for the muscle and FCR's (70 cm3) far too large, i.e. the line between them is not the PT/FCR/FPL septum. Kept together (105 cm3).

mobile_wad_compartment.note: BR/ECRL on a pale line at 68 % of 65 shared levels, ECRL/ECRB at 68 % of 62: the weakest extensor boundaries. The BR region (163 cm3) also holds the brachialis and biceps at the elbow levels (the position rules have no marker for them), so the compartment (264 cm3) is the anterolateral mass, not the three muscles alone.

extensor_digitorum_supinator_anconeus_co.note: Anconeus/supinator on a pale line at only 44 % of 16 shared levels and ED/anconeus at 44 % of 9; the anconeus region (1.9 cm3) is too small to be the muscle, so ED, whose other boundaries hold (72-100 %), is kept with the two proximal muscles (49 cm3) rather than shipped with a border that does not run on a septum.
